  WHY: `_log_semble_event()` was removed, so the success event disappears and the fallback output no longer contains `ms=`, making these assertions fail deterministically.

  WHY: Reviewers agree the old clamp to [1,20] is gone, allowing 0/negative/very large values to cause errors or oversized queries.

  PROBLEM: Removing `_log_semble_event()` broke the structured Semble telemetry contract.
  WHY: Success `SEMBLE_QUERY` events are now silent and fallback logs lost `chunks=`/`ms=`, so downstream log consumers and parsers can break.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-443 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The Semble-enriched diagnose context block was removed from `implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh`.
  WHY: Without `build_diagnose_semble_query()` / `semble_query_block()`, the diagnose prompt gets less repo context and diagnostic quality drops; several reviewers also note the file is out of the issue's stated scope.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:396-411 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The install step leaves `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE` false, so the build-index step always skips.
  WHY: Grok and z-ai both report the workflow never flips the env var to `true`, making the Semble index feature non-functional; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and minimax_minimax-m2_5 called this a false positive because `install_semble.sh` writes `SEMBLE_AVAILABLE=true` to `GITHUB_ENV`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 735-785) and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (lines 39-93) | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The same Semble helper functions are duplicated in both scripts.
  WHY: Any fix or improvement has to be applied in two places, increasing maintenance burden and divergence risk.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Both files were modified even though neither appears in the issue's stated "Files likely to change" list.
  WHY: Reviewers treat the out-of-scope edits as scope creep because they introduce regressions outside the intended Semble prefetch changes.
